design-polish.primaryDecision: Finish follows product meaning and applicable state evidence rather than a universal polish recipe.

design-taste.primaryDecision: Name the visual symptom and justify only novel, divergent, global, or approval-bearing choices.

improve-composition.primaryDecision: Choose the canonical behavior owner and prove propagation through consumers, catalogs, and tests.

improve-layout.primaryDecision: Preserve spatial intent at the lightest owner across actual content and viewport pressure.

improve-motion.primaryDecision: Decide whether motion belongs, preserve identity, and choose the lightest capable mechanism.

optimistic-ui.primaryDecision: Use honest local-first state only when failure, rollback, concurrency, and server preconditions remain recoverable.

quality-audit.primaryDecision: Prioritize reproduced whole-repository risk by impact, reach, confidence, and proof.

shadcn-tailwind.primaryDecision: Resolve exact mechanics from installed configuration, source, types, compiler, language server, and computed styles.

ship.primaryDecision: Follow the repository's delivery boundary through current-head checks and feedback without merging.

zoom-out.primaryDecision: Re-derive the project's real purpose and center of gravity from evidence instead of restating its docs.

flavored-md.primaryDecision: Choose the smallest GitHub-rendered Markdown structure that serves lookup and scanning.

saltintesta.primaryDecision: Express the idea in the fewest good words without deleting necessary meaning.

design-craft.primaryDecision: Choose the smallest product-native visual signal that communicates hierarchy, affordance, state, or character.
